title: Renew or restore a conveyancer licence – individual
summary: This page explains how to renew or restore an individual conveyancer licence in NSW.
intro:
If you are a licensed conveyancer a renewal notice will be emailed to you approximately 60 days before the licence expires. You can then renew your licence online before the due date.

If your licence has expired:

You cannot do legal work for property transactions in NSW if your licence has expired.

### Change of details

You can update your email address and mobile number when you renew online. If other details need to be updated, refer to change the details on a conveyancer licence.

### Check your licence

To find your conveyancer licence number and details, visit Verify NSW.
who_can_apply: Be a fit and proper person to hold a licence and not be disqualified.
Meet the requirements for continuing professional development.
Be covered by an approved policy of professional indemnity insurance when working (this can be through your own policy or your employer’s policy).
what_you_need: Your renewal number (as shown on your renewal notice)

how_to_steps.text: Select the 'Renew or restore online' button.
Log in or create your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to renew a conveyancer licence.
Print and complete your renewal notice.
Visit a Service NSW Centre along with your proof of identity documents and payment.

faqs.q: What happens if my conveyancer licence expires?
faqs.a: You cannot do legal work for property transactions in NSW if your licence has expired.

faqs.q: How do I find my conveyancer licence number?
faqs.a: You can visit Verify NSW to find your conveyancer licence number and details.

faqs.q: When will I receive notice about renewing my licence?
faqs.a: A renewal notice will be emailed to you approximately 60 days before the licence expires.
